closure.closed_on.description: Label of the server's closing date (closes_at, ADR-0088), shown in UTC next to it on the static closure page.

closure.description.defaultMessage: {server} ha cerrado y ya no está en funcionamiento. Sus cuentas y publicaciones han desaparecido y ya no se pueden exportar sus datos. Gracias por usarlo.
closure.description.description: Explanation under the heading of the static closure page (my admin closure export-html). {server} is the server's name, or its host name.

closure.document_title.description: <title> of the static closure page. {server} is the server's name, or its host name.

closure.notice.description: Heading over the administrators' message of the closure announcement on the static closure page.

closure.status_page.description: Text of the link to the instance's status page (status_page_url) on the static closure page.

closure.title.description: Heading of the static closure page that the server's domain serves after the closure of the service (ADR-0088 §6).
